description: Replaces dependabot once the Mend Renovate GitHub App is installed on the repo. Mirrors the old cadence (weekly, grouped minor+patch, PRs against dev — memory rule: test locally on dev before merging) and adds what dependabot lacked: Gradle (android), CocoaPods (ios), the dependency dashboard issue, and lockfile maintenance.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: majors stay individual PRs — release-notes check for required code changes is part of the merge procedure

#562: the connector agents' browser is ONE version in two places — the Playwright image the agent runs on and the Microsoft.Playwright package that drives its bundled Chromium. A drift between them fails every agent at launch, so they move together in one PR, raised as soon as Playwright releases: that Chromium is what a bank judges outdated (docs/connectors/deploy.md, 'Keeping the agents' browsers current'). The ONE group that merges itself into dev once its checks are green (user ruling on #562): the image build and the NAS deploy that follow renew every pooled agent without anybody's hand

customManagers.description: the platform stacks' Logto image is pinned in a JS template the docker-compose manager cannot see — same depName as the dev-source compose, so both bump in one PR
